description: Five with-skill-only archived CASE reconstruction scenarios (two-stage content confirmation; CASE reviewed by the main session without user confirmation).

evals.name: Archived PLAN uses current HEAD
evals.prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. Rebuild CASE verification for the archived full task with an existing PLAN, using the default current target branch. The initial request is not a confirmation: stop for a new user message confirming the PRD content (Phase 1.1) and another for the PLAN content (Phase 1.4) before start. The CASE itself needs no user confirmation. Complete real CASE execution and coverage, then archive only the new task.
evals.expected_output: An independent full task validates current HEAD, historical CASE/RESULT is only a reference, and the original archive is unchanged.
assertions: The new task has no parent and records matching sourceTask/sourceCommit/current validation metadata in task.json.meta and CASE.
The default validation commit equals the fixture's initial HEAD, not a guessed historical commit.
Metadata records validationRefSource=default-current-branch and a reason explaining the default target branch.
Historical CASE/RESULT remains unchanged and is not reused as the current result.
Real SR/C execution and coverage or a justified not_applicable result exist.
PRD and PLAN content confirmations each wait for an independent user message; the CASE needs none.
The original archive manifest is byte-identical before and after the new task archive.

evals.name: Legacy materials use an explicit ref
evals.prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. Rebuild CASE verification for the archived full task with design.md + implement.md using ref <base-ref>. The initial request is not a confirmation: stop for a new user message confirming the PRD content (Phase 1.1) and another for the PLAN content (Phase 1.4) before start. The CASE itself needs no user confirmation. Migrate only inside the new task, execute real cases, and keep the original archive unchanged.
evals.expected_output: A unique local branch points to the requested commit, the new task migrates legacy materials internally, and the original is untouched.
assertions: The requested ref resolves to a unique local branch at the exact commit; the validation worktree is not detached.
The created validation worktree HEAD equals the requested 40-character commit, proving the code baseline is not current HEAD.
Evidence contains the ref-side src/current.txt content 'base' and not the current-HEAD content 'current'.
RESULT codeFingerprint equals an independent task-fingerprint.mjs run on the requested ref worktree.
design.md + implement.md are handled only inside the new task and produce a valid plan.md.
Source metadata distinguishes the requested validation commit from the archive bookkeeping commit.
Real execution records a passing RESULT with a current code fingerprint.
PRD and PLAN content confirmations each wait for an independent user message; the CASE is reviewed by the main session only.
The original archive manifest is byte-identical after completion.

evals.name: PRD-only archive is explicitly rebuilt
evals.prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. Rebuild CASE verification for the archived full task that has only PRD material. Mark the missing PLAN explicitly and create a new PRD/PLAN. The initial request is not a confirmation: stop for a new user message confirming the PRD content (Phase 1.1) and another for the PLAN content (Phase 1.4) before start. The CASE itself needs no user confirmation. Execute the real CASE and preserve the original archive bytes.
evals.expected_output: The new task explicitly documents PRD-only input, authors a new PLAN, and completes real verification without changing the original.
assertions: The new PRD explicitly records PRD-only material and does not claim an existing implementation plan.
A structurally valid new plan.md is created before startup.
No historical confirmation record is reused as current confirmation or result evidence.
The new CASE executes with real evidence and coverage status after the main session's review.
PRD and PLAN content confirmations each wait for an independent user message; the CASE needs none.
The original archive manifest is byte-identical after completion.

evals.name: No path requires candidate selection
evals.prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. Ask for archived CASE verification without naming a task. List the eligible archived full tasks with titles, paths, and completedAt values, then stop for my selection. Do not create a task before I choose. After I select, only confirm the selection and stop; do not create a task in this selection-only scenario.
evals.expected_output: The skill lists only eligible archived full tasks and creates nothing before selection; after selection, this selection-only run stops without creating a task.
assertions: The candidate list contains the expected archived full tasks sorted by completedAt descending.
Light and non-completed tasks are excluded.
No new task directory or local validation branch is created before selection, and the selection-only run stops without creating one afterward.
The original archive manifests remain unchanged.

evals.name: Invalid input fails without writes
evals.prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. Attempt archived CASE verification first with an outside task path and then with a nonexistent ref. Both must fail before creating a new task or modifying the archive. Report the exact errors.
evals.expected_output: Both invalid inputs fail explicitly with no task creation, no validation branch, and no archive changes.
assertions: The outside archived path is rejected before any write.
The nonexistent ref is rejected before any write.
No new task directory or validation branch is created.
The original archive manifest is byte-identical after both failures.
